This flower is found chiefly in frigid climates, especially in mountains, and is best known in north-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains of legendary rarity.

To obtain its properties, it must be prepared as an infusion or decoction.

The potion compels its victim to serve or love the person who gave it to them for 1–100 days, though it will not make the victim willingly harm themself.
